name: Fompedraza (Spain)
description: Crimson red field charged at the centre with the crowned arms of Fompedraza (a face on yellow, a castle and grapes).
history: In 2015 the town council of Fompedraza unveiled a flag and arms, published in the Boletín Oficial de la Provincia de Valladolid: the arms of Spanish shape with three quarters, the upper bearing the face of the Infante Don Juan Manuel from the Mudéjar coffered ceiling found in the parish church on a golden field; the flag of dimensions 1:2, crimson red (or gules), bearing the municipal arms.
